tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by four different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Wikimedia Foundation warns that a recent artificial intelligence copyright ruling could threaten the open web. Confirmed by Crypto Briefing: Wikimedia urges courts to protect artificial intelligence training but not chatbot outputs that regurgitate content.
Mistral released a 1T-parameter open model for self-hosting. Reported by The Neuron: the company also offers a cyber variant for vetted partners.
Trump used Grok to advise on Venezuela, and Congress demands the artificial intelligence chatbot logs be preserved. Reported by Tech Times: the Department of Justice then called the Presidential Records Act unconstitutional.
In 2015, Larry Page envisioned galaxy exploration by 2100 via von Neumann probes, with Elon Musk endorsing the idea. Reported by The Times of India: Microsoft artificial intelligence CEO Mustafa Suleyman recalls the sci-fi vision from a lunch.
Orange Cyberdefense gains early access to Mistral artificial intelligence's cybersecurity variant for European clients. Reported by LEPTIDIGITAL: 82 percent of failles are corrected according to Mistral.
Free every hour.
